tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med lha dgu la brten nas 'chi bslu mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ 'chi bslu mthong ba don grub ces tshe dpag med lha dgu la brten pa zhig mkhan chen zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa 'di'i/ rgyal chen bzhi la gtor ma 'bul ba rdzogs pa'i rjes su byed na/ rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ rgyas pa ltar na so sor 'bul bas/ thog mar yul 'khor srung gi gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ dh+ri ta raṣ+ṭa ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ gsum sogs kyis bsngos/ oṃ dh+ri ta raṣ+ṭa ye sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta'i bar 'gre/ sgrub grogs mang po yod cing sgrub mchod kyi mchod pa rnams la rnga rol dung sogs byas na 'di'i shap+ta la dril gsil rnga rol dung sogs byas la/ bstod pa dang 'phrin 'chol la rnga brdung byed na/ bstod pa'i dbyangs rol gdan sa 'dir yang dag don du 'thad pas mchod rol gyi rjes su sum brdeg lan can byas la/ rnga brdung zhing / rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog mtshungs pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la dbyangs dang sum brdeg lan can/ yul 'khor srung ba 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar 'dur shur gang rung gi mthar tshig rol byas la bzhag

de bzhin du 'phags skyes po sogs 'og ma gsum la'ang / gtor ma bsang sbyang nas 'phrin 'chol tshig rol rdzogs pa'i bar rigs 'gre la/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa so so/ 'phags pa skyes po 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes dang / mig mi bzang ba 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes dang / rnam thos sras po 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes par bsgyur/ rnam sras 'phrin 'chol gyi tshig rol rjes su sbraṃ/ sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig byas gnyis byas gsum byas dgu brdung / 'theng rkang gnyis che gcig rnga phyir brdung gis/ 'di ni lho yi sogs sh+lau ka gsum la chos nyid ma'i bzlog dbyangs rol mo bcas tshar gsum/ sngon shes nas dbyangs med/ bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog dang / /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs rnams la tshig rol dgu brdung byas la rnga rol bzhag bden bdar gyi mthar bgegs gtor dor ba ltar rdor dril gsor dkrol drag dung bcas kyis gshin rje phyir rdzong ngo / /yang rgyal chen gtor 'bul bsdus pa ltar na gzhung bzhin la bstod pa sh+lau ka re rer dbyangs rol re dang 'phrin 'chol man gong bzhin/ yang rang gcig pu yin na rgyal chen gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus gang ltar na'ang dril bsil byas la/ de nas rnga rol khad kyis blangs te/ sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig byas man gong bzhin bsgrub bya dngos su med na tshon skud sna lnga'i glud gos bcings bzhin pa de la gnod byed dgug gzhug byas la me chu'i ngar blud pa'i ral gris gtub cing gang dag sangs rgyas sogs brjod/ gtub ro rnams g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas glud gso la g.yon skor lan gsum bskor te snod du bzhag pa tsam khyad par ma gtogs de phyin 'dra zhing 'brang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag la gsar rnying rtsis bon 'jig rten phal pa rnams bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba yod kyang gsar ma ltar na gzhung 'di nyid bzhin no/ /zhes pa'ang sa skya kun blos zin bris nyung ngur sbyar ba'o//
